text.en:
Section two hundred and thirty-two of Act Numbered One hundred and ninety is hereby
amended by adding thereto the following paragraph:
"5. The person defeated in a civil action concerning the ownership or possession of real estate who, after
having been evicted by the sheriff from the realty under litigation in compliance with the judgment rendered,
shall enter or attempt to enter upon the same for the purpose of executing acts of ownership or possession or
who shall in any manner disturb possession by the person whom the sheriff placed in possession of said

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, October 24, 1924.
